messages:
Omar: noticed a tenant with -$5.60 under 'cache savings' on the cost cards after yesterday's routing fallback.
Zoe: negative savings again? that's confusing for customers.
Omar: panel query is `SELECT tenant_id, SUM(token_cost) burn, SUM(cache_saving) savings FROM econ_7d GROUP BY tenant_id`. cache_saving can be negative due to amortized prefetch refunds.
Ben: we intentionally emit signed cache_saving in ingest so billing is accurate. UI assumed savings >= 0.
Yuki: UX approach: surface three numbers -> prefetch_credits_used (>=0), amortized_prefetch_loss (>=0), net_prefetch_savings (signed). color-code net and include a tooltip explaining TTL evictions.
Zoe: agree. Also we must not use net_prefetch_savings naively in quota soft-credits; amortized_loss should be a penalty.
Ben: telemetry fallout: router currently only writes final model_sku, losing intent attribution when fallbacks happen. we should add optional `intent_route` in telemetry events.
Yuki: optional fields are backwards compatible; we'll version telemetry to v2 and default consumers to final_route.
Omar: perf question: can the tenant heatmap still be <200ms if we show three fields?
Ben: yes if we precompute two extra aggregates in the materialized view at ingest. small MV change and backfill.
ops-bot: checklist: publish telemetry v2 contract, canary ingest consumers, add MV columns & backfill outside billing window, UI behind feature flag, 24h canary.
Zoe: I'll draft the RFC for wording and the UI mock. tag when API PR is up.
Omar: thanks all, will follow up with the RFC link here.
